title: Lights-Out
description: Why using a modpack when you can have so much content in a single mod?
body:
Lights Out is the ultimate horror experience, adding nearly 300 new creatures to Minecraft, many of them highly aggressive, from a variety of sources like Terraria, Subnautica, SCP, films, legends, and more. These terrifying creatures roam across all biomes, making every corner of your world a potential danger zone or a new found. Discover new ores, weapons, armor, and items, all designed to help you survive against the growing threats. Discover new biomes, mysterious secret tablets, and even an eerie shadow dimension. From the Tutorial Boss to 9 main bosses, and finally, the End Boss, Lights Out is a full-fledged progression mod filled with endless content, new challenges, and mysteries to uncover. 

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

► In the console it can happen that many entities try to spawn, but appear as removed already.


This issue is normal and has something to do with the spawning condition.
It doesn't allow cave entities to spawn on the surface or doesn't allow entities from events to spawn if the event is disabled.

► The End becomes very laggy

Many Entites will spawn in the end.
We set the spawning on 1% which is the lowest we can do but nothing really changed...

► Where to find Slimes?

Cave Slime: Only in Caves

Blood Slime: Only in Flesh Pit Biom or during an Blood Horde Event

Ice Slime: Snowy Bioms

Electro Slime: Only during Thunderstorms

Toxic Slime: Only in Swamps, Mangroves and Toxic Wasteland

Lava Slime: Only in the Nether

Golden Slime: Everywhere, but spawns very rare

Pumpkin Slime: Only in Autumn Forests

Balloon Slime: Only during Thunderstorms

Royal Slime: Only during the battle from King Slime

King Slime: Only by right clicking a "KIng Slime Ball" Item


You can also craft the 6 Slime balls you need for spawning King Slime by yourself.

► How to trigger Events?

There are 5 Events in the Mod.

Zombie Hordes: There are 4 Zombie Hordes (Normal, Big, Huge, Toxic) that can randomly trigger during night time.

Alien Invasion: An Alien Invasion will only trigger, if a Messanger UFO dies. The Event has 4 Phases, in which more Aliens will spawn.

Horror Night: A Horror Night will trigger with a 5% chance during night. It will last several minutes, even in daytime. During the event, horror monsters will spawn a lot more often, but will also drop new stuff. The Event can be triggered by using a Broken Mirror during night and can be disabled by using a Mirror.

Halloween: Halloween will trigger with a 1% chance during night. It will last several minutes, even in daytime. During the event, Treaters, Candy Creepers and Candy Zombies can spawn. The Event can be triggered by using a Filled Pumpkin Bucket during night and can be disabled by using an Empty Pumpkin Bucket.

Blood Horde: A Blood Horde will trigger with a 1% chance during night. It will last several minutes, even in daytime. During the event, blood and flesh creatures from the Flesh Pit can spawn on the surface. The Event can be triggered by using a Demon Stone during night and can be disabled by using a Holy Stone.


► Which are the bosses?

Tutorial Boss
King Slime: Can be summon by using a King Slime Ball. It appears as a Giant Slime with a crown on the top. When he is defeated, he can drop a Slime Pickaxe, a King Slime Trophy and a lot of Slime Balls.

Main Bosses
Mouring Wood: Can be summon by using a Mourning Sapling. It appears as a giant tree with a burning smily face. When he is defeated, he can drop a Raw Plasmalit, a Mourning Wood Trophy and a Soul of Fright.

Pumpking: Can be summon by using a Pumpkin Doll. It appears as a giant pumpkin head, with 2 arms and a robe. When he is defeated, he can drop a Raw Plasmalit, a Pumpking Trophy and a Soul of Night.

Hand Master: Can be summon by using a Rotten Hand. It appears as a Giant Hand. When he is defeated, he can drop a Raw Plasmalit, a Hand Master Trophy and a Soul of Magic.

Elders Brain: Can be summon by using a Suspicious Brain. It appears as a Giant Brain with a Huge Eye and 4 Tentacles on every side. When he is defeated, he can drop a Raw Plasmalit, a Elders Brain Trophy and a Soul of Knowledge.

Cryoma: Can be summon by using a Ice Star. It appears as a Giant Snowflake, made out of ice. When he is defeated, he can drop a Raw Plasmalit, a  Trophy and a Soul of Frost.

Destroyer: Can be summon by using a Reactor. It appears as a Giant Robot. When he is defeated, he can drop a Raw Plasmalit, a Destroyer Trophy and a Soul of Might.

Margmar: Can be summon by using an Infernal Skull. It appears as a Huge Magma Lizard. When he is defeated, he can drop a Raw Plasmalit, a Margmar Trophy and a Soul of Fire.

Radiated Abomination: Can be summon by using a Void Squid. It appears as a giant Squid with a huge body, a massive mouth and 8 tentacles. When he is defeated, he can drop a Raw Plasmalit, a  Trophy and a Soul of Destruction.

Root of Evil: Can be summon by using an Ancient Root. It appears as a giant Root with tentacles and an eye on the top of the root. When he is defeated, he can drop a Raw Plasmalit, a  Trophy and a Soul of Evilness.

End Boss
Overseer: Can be summon by using an All-Seeing Eye. It appears as an accurate biblican angle with rings, a massive eye in the middle and wings on the side. When he is defeated, he can drop a Hallowed Ingots, an Overseer Trophy and an All-Seeing Eye.

► How to build a Downside Portal?

A Downside Portal can be build like an Nether Portal. It leads you into the Downside Dimension, a pitch black dimension with lot of danger. Be prepared with Adamantit Equipment if you want to survive there.

To Build it, you need Bloody Obsidian which you can get by crafting it with obsidian and a blood bottle. To activate the Portal, you need a bloody tear which you can craft with a ghast tear and a blood bottle.

Blood Bottles can be crafted with a bloody rotten flesh (which you can get by killing blood and flesh creatures) and a glass bottle.

► Where to find Blood Zombies?

Blood Zombies can spawn with a 15% chance. They also spawn with a higher chance during an Blood Horde Event or in Flesh Pit Bioms.
